entries.progression: Joined as an intern and continued under an open-ended employment contract.
responsibilities: I develop and maintain business applications using Python, Django, Java, Spring Boot, React and PostgreSQL. My work includes building APIs, integrating systems, automating workflows and handling application data.
contributions: Implemented bulk data import workflows with pre-import validation, duplicate checks and per-record results.
Developed backend features, APIs and business logic using Python/Django and Java/Spring Boot.
Implemented and improved access controls to restrict information according to user roles and associated entities.
Developed scheduled workflows, automatic renewal processes and error recovery mechanisms.
Resolved data inconsistencies involving historical records, migrations, indicators and reports.
